title: Drowzee's Itchy-Nose Dream Trap
premise: An itchy nose during sleep may signal Drowzee standing above your pillow and eating your dream.
audiencePromise: Follow one strange Pokédex clue from an itchy nose to Drowzee's dream-eating method.
openLoop: What connects one itchy nose to a dream Drowzee eats?
payoff: The whole trap clicks: Drowzee's nose finds the sleeper, then its nostrils lead to the dream.
engagementQuestion: Is dream-eating Drowzee clever, or too creepy to trust?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a creepy surprise. Start urgent, build tension with each clue, pause before the reveals, then end playful and inviting.

scenes.headline: ITCHY NOSE? DROWZEE'S EATING
scenes.narration: An itchy sleeping nose means Drowzee is eating dreams.
scenes.caption: THE ITCH IS A WARNING

scenes.headline: ITS NOSE FINDS SLEEPERS
scenes.narration: Its twitching nose can find sleepers and their dreams.
scenes.caption: DROWZEE KNOWS WHERE TO LOOK

scenes.headline: IT CAN READ THE DREAM
scenes.narration: It can tell what a sleeping person is dreaming about.
scenes.caption: THE DREAM ISN'T HIDDEN

scenes.headline: THE PATH GOES THROUGH YOUR NOSE
scenes.narration: Then it eats that dream through your nostrils, above the pillow.
scenes.caption: DREAM THEFT FROM ABOVE

scenes.headline: IT REMEMBERS EVERY DREAM
scenes.narration: Drowzee remembers every dream it eats and sometimes shows them later.
scenes.caption: EATEN DREAMS CAN RETURN

scenes.headline: CLEVER OR TOO CREEPY?
scenes.narration: Is dream-eating Drowzee clever, or too creepy to trust?
scenes.caption: DREAM EATER OR BEDTIME THIEF?
